preprocessing.source: original PNG at image_relpath (pixels only; no mask, bbox or metadata)
preprocessing.color: single grayscale channel, 8 bit (mode 'L'); other modes are rejected
preprocessing.geometry: whole image scaled down proportionally to fit (PIL.ImageOps.contain), centred on a black canvas; no crop, no stretch
preprocessing.side_rounding: Pillow rounds the scaled side with Python round() (half to even)
preprocessing.centering: offset = (target - scaled) // 2; an odd remainder lies right/bottom
preprocessing.scaling: float32(uint8) / 255 -> [0, 1]; fixed, nothing estimated from data
preprocessing.flatten: row-major (C order), then C-contiguous float64 for scikit-learn (exact conversion)

evaluation.rule: score >= threshold; no threshold optimisation or calibration

runtime_note: CPU measurements of this run; no basis for estimating neural-network training time.
output_note: Model binaries are local and are not expected to be byte-identical between runs.
limitations: Low resolution (64x64) and a linear model on raw pixels are part of this simple baseline; the later comparison evaluates whole pipelines.
Padding and the remaining image content do not remove possible device-specific cues (burned-in markers, image layout, size).
One fixed holdout, one institution; images of one case are not independent patients.
Scores are not calibrated probabilities; the 0.5 threshold is a fixed convention.
Train-set metrics only describe possible overfitting.
